analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: We may disclose your personal information with: Our parent company, PayPal, Inc. and affiliates and subsidiaries it controls, but only for purposes allowed by this document.

analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: Partners and merchants, their service providers and others involved in a transaction or our rewards program.

analysis.headline: Shares for Marketing
analysis.quote: For our marketing purposes— to offer our products and services to you Yes No

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: Geolocation Information - information that identifies with reasonable specificity your location by using, for instance, longitude and latitude coordinates obtained through GPS, Wi-Fi, or cell site triangulation.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Face Scans
analysis.quote: Biometric Information - when you consent in the user experience, we collect face scans to authenticate your account and manage fraud and risk.

analysis.headline: Keeps Your Data For Years
analysis.quote: Personal Information used for the ongoing relationship between you and Venmo is stored for the duration of the relationship plus a period of 10 years, unless we need to keep it longer, such as: a legal obligation or compliance with laws to which we are subject is retained consistent with the applicable law, such as under Anti-Money Laundering obligations litigation, investigations, audit, and compliance practices, or to protect against legal claims.

analysis.headline: Your Data Is Public by Default
analysis.quote: Some personal information is public information and may be seen by anyone on the internet, whether or not they have a Venmo account.

analysis.headline: Parents Monitor Teen Accounts
analysis.quote: Your data is disclosed with the Account Holder: the Account Holder will be able to monitor and access your activities and manage your user and privacy settings.

analysis.headline: Links to Third-Party Accounts
analysis.quote: If you choose to create an account connection, we may receive information from the third-party about you and your use of the third-party’s service.

analysis.headline: Ignores Your DNT Signals
analysis.quote: Do Not Track: Do Not Track ('DNT') is an optional browser setting that allows you to express your preferences regarding tracking by advertisers and other third parties. We do not respond to DNT signals.
